nodes.label: Build and Impact Verification
nodes.rationale: Every pull request explicitly checks build or test status and reviews the affected scope.

nodes.label: Table JSON Schema v1
nodes.rationale: The schema is an editor-generation interchange format, not a runtime data source; it carries version, provenance, table keys, and row objects.

nodes.label: SheetRecipe.json
nodes.rationale: This compact table-to-key map lets the DataTable generator associate each table with its key column and row struct without rescanning row payloads.

nodes.label: Typed Row Struct Binding
nodes.rationale: MVTable metadata, matching field names, and PostRead RowId assignment form one binding contract from JSON table identity to typed runtime lookup.

nodes.label: FMVGenericTableRow
nodes.rationale: A generic key-plus-RowJson fallback keeps untyped tables inspectable, while frequently used gameplay tables should graduate to typed row structs.

nodes.label: Selective Documentation Policy
nodes.rationale: Useful blocks reduce understanding cost near declarations, while blanket coverage creates empty, duplicated, and stale prose.

nodes.label: Graphify Doxygen Extraction Gap
nodes.rationale: graphifyy 0.9.36 extracts C++ structure but not Doxygen prose as semantic nodes, so structural graph parity does not imply equal human understanding.

nodes.label: Local Contract and Canonical Design Split
nodes.rationale: Headers retain type-local contracts, while cross-type flow and design rationale live in semantic-extractable canonical Markdown to avoid duplication.
nodes.norm_label: local contract and canonical design split
